Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for setting out your offer and the cost movements behind it. I understand that alloy and producer costs have been important parts of your calculation, and appreciate your owner’s offer to walk us through it. The more recent movements point in a different direction: the 1.4404 alloy surcharge and producer prices for cold-drawn bars have both fallen. Our last orders for this part were at EUR 5.84 per unit, so we would welcome a price that reflects the current picture as well as the relationship we value with Werdenfels.

You asked what volume we can commit to. Our full demand for this part is fixed and will be placed with you; our forecast is rising, and a long contract gives you planning security. In return for the pricing we ask, we are offering that committed volume over a 36-month term. We have set out two ways to share the commercial risk: a fixed price, or a price linked to the material index with a deadband. Could you let us know which structure suits you better? We hope the commitment and longer planning horizon help support your review with the pricing committee.

The data and our proposal follow.

We confirm a binding volume of 23700 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

The 1.4404 alloy surcharge changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).
Producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 5.84 (po:4500014427-10, po:4500014355-10, po:4500014292-10).

Our proposal in detail, one of these packages:
- Option A: EUR 4.77 per unit, fixed price, payment 45 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 23700 units a year over 36 months
- Option B: EUR 4.72 per unit, price follows AS-14404 on 45% of the price, deadband 5%, payment 45 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 23700 units a year over 36 months

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.
We appreciate your commitment to 23,700 units over a 36-month period, which provides valuable planning security for both sides.
We have verified the recent decreases in the AS-14404 surcharge and producer prices, and have factored these into our revised calculation.
As a 36-month contract requires an index-linked structure to manage risk, we accept your proposed terms with the AS-14404 index and 45-day payment, and offer a revised price of €5.50 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Franz,

Thank you for moving your offer and for taking account of the recent decreases we raised. We appreciate that you have recognized our commitment to a long-term arrangement, and understand the planning security that brings to your business. We also note your explanation that the price follows your main cost drivers and that a larger step needs your pricing committee’s approval.

The binding volume stated below is our full demand for this part over the term, all placed with you. Our demand forecast is rising, and the long contract gives you planning security. In return, we are asking you to move further on price, while retaining an index link to share the relevant cost risk. We hope the fixed volume and term support that step.

Your owner once offered to walk us through your calculation; we would welcome that discussion. The data supporting our position follow, then our proposal with the full terms.

We confirm a binding volume of 23700 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

In our call of 2026-09-04 (doc:20260904-70740-M1) you offered to walk us through your calculation; we would welcome that now.

Our proposal in detail: EUR 4.99 per unit, price follows AS-14404 on 45% of the price, deadband 5.0%, payment 45 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 23700 units a year over 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
